name: PlateFlow New
description: Synthetic plate-manufacturing business records with explicitly declared identifiers and relationships.

tables.definition: Slab identity, steel grade and actual receipt, verification and release times.

columns.name: slab_id
columns.definition: Unique slab identifier; on a plan or mother record, identifies its source slab.

columns.name: charge_id
columns.definition: Steelmaking charge identifier recorded for material genealogy; no casting time is recorded here.

columns.name: steel_grade
columns.definition: Synthetic steel-grade category G1 or G2.

columns.name: received_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC time at which the slab was received.

columns.name: verified_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC time at which the slab identity was verified; NULL if not yet verified.

columns.name: released_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC release time for the slab, rolling plan or plate piece described by this table; NULL if not yet released.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE slab_material(slab_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, charge_id TEXT NOT NULL, steel_grade TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(steel_grade IN ('G1','G2')), received_at TEXT NOT NULL, verified_at TEXT, released_at TEXT, CHECK(verified_at IS NULL OR received_at<=verified_at), CHECK(released_at IS NULL OR (verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_at<=released_at)))

tables.definition: One rolling plan per slab, its scheduled reheating time and actual submission, approval and release times.

columns.name: plan_id
columns.definition: Unique rolling-plan identifier; on an instruction, references its plan.

columns.name: slab_id
columns.definition: Unique slab identifier; on a plan or mother record, identifies its source slab.

columns.name: planned_reheat_at
columns.definition: Scheduled UTC reheating time; a schedule does not establish that reheating occurred.

columns.name: submitted_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC rolling-plan submission time.

columns.name: approved_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC rolling-plan approval time; NULL if not yet approved.

columns.name: released_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC release time for the slab, rolling plan or plate piece described by this table; NULL if not yet released.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE planned_rolling_instruction(plan_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, slab_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES slab_material(slab_id), planned_reheat_at TEXT NOT NULL, submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL, approved_at TEXT, released_at TEXT, CHECK(approved_at IS NULL OR submitted_at<=approved_at), CHECK(released_at IS NULL OR (approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_at<=released_at)))

tables.definition: An issued rolling instruction for an approved plan.

columns.name: instruction_id
columns.definition: Unique rolling-instruction identifier; on a mother record, references the instruction allocating it.

columns.name: plan_id
columns.definition: Unique rolling-plan identifier; on an instruction, references its plan.

columns.name: issued_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC rolling-instruction issue time.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE rolling_instruction(instruction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plan_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES planned_rolling_instruction(plan_id), issued_at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.definition: Allocated mother-material identity and genealogy for a rolling instruction; created_at and updated_at describe database maintenance, not production completion.

columns.name: material_id
columns.definition: Unique mother-material identifier; on a work record, references the mother material processed.

columns.name: plate_no
columns.definition: Unique business plate number within this table; mother and piece numbers have separate ranges.

columns.name: slab_id
columns.definition: Unique slab identifier; on a plan or mother record, identifies its source slab.

columns.name: instruction_id
columns.definition: Unique rolling-instruction identifier; on a mother record, references the instruction allocating it.

columns.name: created_at
columns.definition: UTC database record-creation time; this field does not document a production action.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.definition: UTC database maintenance time; this field does not document a production action.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE as_rolled_material(material_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plate_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, slab_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES slab_material(slab_id), instruction_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES rolling_instruction(instruction_id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(created_at<=updated_at))

tables.definition: Business code meanings within each manufacturing process group. The same code text can have a different meaning in another group.

columns.name: process_group
columns.definition: Business context FURNACE, ROLLING or FINISHING; each work-history table has one fixed group enforced by CHECK.

columns.name: code
columns.definition: Business code within a process group; the pair (process_group,code) uniquely identifies its meaning.

columns.name: meaning
columns.definition: English business meaning of the code in the specified process group.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE process_code(process_group TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(process_group IN ('FURNACE','ROLLING','FINISHING')), code TEXT NOT NULL, meaning TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(process_group,code))

tables.definition: Equipment identifiers, names and system-maintenance times. Each equipment_code identifies a machine, not a manufacturing step.

columns.name: equipment_id
columns.definition: Unique equipment-unit identifier; on a work record, references the unit that performed the work.

columns.name: equipment_code
columns.definition: Human-readable machine code; identifies the machine, not the work performed.

columns.name: equipment_name
columns.definition: English equipment-unit name.

columns.name: created_at
columns.definition: UTC database record-creation time; this field does not document a production action.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.definition: UTC database maintenance time; this field does not document a production action.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE equipment(equipment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, equipment_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, equipment_name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(created_at<=updated_at))

tables.definition: Actual furnace work occurrences for mother materials, retaining repeat work and unfinished intervals.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.definition: Unique work-occurrence identifier within this table; repeat work receives a new identifier.

columns.name: material_id
columns.definition: Unique mother-material identifier; on a work record, references the mother material processed.

columns.name: process_group
columns.definition: Business context FURNACE, ROLLING or FINISHING; each work-history table has one fixed group enforced by CHECK.

columns.name: operation_code
columns.definition: Kind of manufacturing work performed, as defined by the matching process_group/code entry.

columns.name: equipment_id
columns.definition: Unique equipment-unit identifier; on a work record, references the unit that performed the work.

columns.name: started_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC start of this manufacturing work occurrence or quality-review round.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC finish of this manufacturing work occurrence or quality-review round; NULL if unfinished.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE furnace_operation_history(operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES as_rolled_material(material_id), process_group TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FURNACE' CHECK(process_group='FURNACE'), operation_code TEXT NOT NULL, equipment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment(equipment_id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(process_group,operation_code) REFERENCES process_code(process_group,code), CHECK(finished_at IS NULL OR started_at<finished_at))

tables.definition: Actual rolling phase occurrences for mother materials, retaining repeat work and unfinished intervals.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.definition: Unique work-occurrence identifier within this table; repeat work receives a new identifier.

columns.name: material_id
columns.definition: Unique mother-material identifier; on a work record, references the mother material processed.

columns.name: process_group
columns.definition: Business context FURNACE, ROLLING or FINISHING; each work-history table has one fixed group enforced by CHECK.

columns.name: phase_code
columns.definition: Rolling phase performed, as defined by the matching process_group/code entry.

columns.name: equipment_id
columns.definition: Unique equipment-unit identifier; on a work record, references the unit that performed the work.

columns.name: started_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC start of this manufacturing work occurrence or quality-review round.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC finish of this manufacturing work occurrence or quality-review round; NULL if unfinished.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE rolling_operation_history(operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES as_rolled_material(material_id), process_group TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ROLLING' CHECK(process_group='ROLLING'), phase_code TEXT NOT NULL, equipment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment(equipment_id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(process_group,phase_code) REFERENCES process_code(process_group,code), CHECK(finished_at IS NULL OR started_at<finished_at))

tables.definition: Individual plate-piece identity and mother-material genealogy, with actual identification, release and packing times.

columns.name: plate_id
columns.definition: Unique individual plate-piece identifier; on work, inspection or review records, references the piece concerned.

columns.name: plate_no
columns.definition: Unique business plate number within this table; mother and piece numbers have separate ranges.

columns.name: mother_material_id
columns.definition: Mother material from which the individual plate piece was derived.

columns.name: identified_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC time at which the plate piece was identified after rolling.

columns.name: released_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC release time for the slab, rolling plan or plate piece described by this table; NULL if not yet released.

columns.name: packed_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC packing-completion time; NULL if not yet packed.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE plate_material(plate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plate_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, mother_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES as_rolled_material(material_id), identified_at TEXT NOT NULL, released_at TEXT, packed_at TEXT, CHECK(released_at IS NULL OR identified_at<=released_at), CHECK(packed_at IS NULL OR (released_at IS NOT NULL AND released_at<=packed_at)))

tables.definition: Actual finishing work occurrences for individual plate pieces, including repeated heat treatment after rework.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.definition: Unique work-occurrence identifier within this table; repeat work receives a new identifier.

columns.name: plate_id
columns.definition: Unique individual plate-piece identifier; on work, inspection or review records, references the piece concerned.

columns.name: process_group
columns.definition: Business context FURNACE, ROLLING or FINISHING; each work-history table has one fixed group enforced by CHECK.

columns.name: operation_code
columns.definition: Kind of manufacturing work performed, as defined by the matching process_group/code entry.

columns.name: equipment_id
columns.definition: Unique equipment-unit identifier; on a work record, references the unit that performed the work.

columns.name: started_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC start of this manufacturing work occurrence or quality-review round.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC finish of this manufacturing work occurrence or quality-review round; NULL if unfinished.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE finishing_operation_history(operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plate_material(plate_id), process_group TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FINISHING' CHECK(process_group='FINISHING'), operation_code TEXT NOT NULL, equipment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment(equipment_id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(process_group,operation_code) REFERENCES process_code(process_group,code), CHECK(finished_at IS NULL OR started_at<finished_at))

tables.definition: One dimensional inspection record per inspection occurrence. Reinspection has a new inspection_id; PASS/FAIL describes its result.

columns.name: inspection_id
columns.definition: Unique dimensional-inspection occurrence identifier; distinct for each reinspection.

columns.name: plate_id
columns.definition: Unique individual plate-piece identifier; on work, inspection or review records, references the piece concerned.

columns.name: inspected_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC dimensional-inspection completion time.

columns.name: result_code
columns.definition: Inspection outcome PASS or FAIL; either value represents a completed dimensional inspection.

columns.name: thickness_mm
columns.definition: Synthetic measured thickness in millimetres.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE dimension_inspection(inspection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plate_material(plate_id), inspected_at TEXT NOT NULL, result_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(result_code IN ('PASS','FAIL')), thickness_mm REAL NOT NULL CHECK(thickness_mm>0))

tables.definition: One quality review record per review round. APPROVED/REWORK describes its outcome; PENDING means the review has not finished.

columns.name: review_id
columns.definition: Unique quality-review round identifier; distinct for each subsequent review.

columns.name: plate_id
columns.definition: Unique individual plate-piece identifier; on work, inspection or review records, references the piece concerned.

columns.name: started_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC start of this manufacturing work occurrence or quality-review round.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC finish of this manufacturing work occurrence or quality-review round; NULL if unfinished.

columns.name: review_status
columns.definition: APPROVED or REWORK for a finished quality review, PENDING for an unfinished review.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE plate_quality_review(review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plate_material(plate_id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, review_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(review_status IN ('APPROVED','REWORK','PENDING')), CHECK((review_status='PENDING' AND finished_at IS NULL) OR (review_status IN ('APPROVED','REWORK') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at<finished_at)))

business_rules: Each plan concerns one slab. Each issued instruction refers to one plan. Mother and plate-piece identifiers refer to distinct physical materials.
A mother-material identity can be allocated before work finishes. Database creation and maintenance times are not evidence of production completion.
Every work occurrence retains its own identifier. Repeat work, reinspection and later review rounds retain separate records.
Each work-history table is restricted to its declared process group. Code meanings are resolved within that group.
Review outcome and inspection result describe the result of the same kind of business record; they do not change its business purpose.
Actual start times may exist without finish times. NULL finish means unfinished work; NULL release/packing means not yet released/packed.
Scheduled reheating time is a plan and may differ from actual heating time.
An approved quality review is required before piece release; packing follows release.
All business records, identifiers, times and measurements are synthetic.
